nyheter.title: Peacoat Evicted from Navy Seabags After a Century at Sea
nyheter.summary: The traditional Navy peacoat will be no more. A new Navy uniform policy released on Friday removes the peacoat, acrylic V-neck sweater and dinner dress white jacket from a sailor’s seabag beginning on Oct. 1, 2027. Sailors may still wear the wool V-neck sweater. Instead of the dinner dress white jacket, sailors will now use the dinner dress blue jacket as the standard formal uniform year-round, according to the policy.
